WHY THE CONTRACT SWEEPS LIVE HERE AND NOT BESIDE THE CONTRACTS (Round 1138).
Round 1088 tracked the first one at `crates/mnemosyne-cli/tests/`, and that
location cost it both halves of being a proof. `read_manifest` resolves `repo`
against the MANIFEST'S OWN directory, so a `repo` of `.` there named the tests
directory and every edit resolved under it — the sweep could not have run at
all. And `tools/injection-harness/tests/sweeps.rs`, the law that exists to
catch an anchor that has come loose, classifies any tracked manifest under a
`tests/` component as a TEST INPUT and skips it, so nothing said so. A
directory cargo owns is not a place to keep something runnable; `sweeps/` is
a sweep home the law already recognises, and both manifests moved here.
`frame_view_playable_agreement.rs` states eight laws and shipped GREEN — which
says the laws hold, and says nothing at all about whether they could break.
Each injection below breaks ONE READ, never a test, and names the test that
must go red for it.
SCOPE IS THE WHOLE WORKSPACE, and Round 1139 widened it from
`-p mnemosyne-cli` because the narrower run could not answer the question
this file asks. The edits land in `mnemosyne-validate`, so under `-p` THE
EDITED CRATE'S OWN SUITE NEVER RAN: a law its unit tests already guard and a
law nothing guards came back as the same red set. Which packages could
notice at all is measured rather than argued — of the separate workspaces
this repository tracks, not one resolves `mnemosyne-validate` (`studio`, the
only other consumer of Mnemosyne crates, reaches core, atomic and query and
stops), so the root workspace is exactly the population that can go red and
`--workspace` is the widest reading of it there is.
WHAT THE WIDENED RUN SAID (Round 1139, control 1843 passed / 0 failed / 157
targets, no target drift on any run): ALL SEVEN FIRED, MISSED 0, over 41
reds against the 29 the crate-scoped run could reach. TWELVE REDS WERE
INVISIBLE TO THE NARROWER SCOPE — ten `continuity::tests::…`, the edited
crate's own unit tests, and two in `mnemosyne-mcp`, a consumer surface no
reading of the CLI's suite could have named at all.
AND THE ONE CLAIM THIS FILE MAKES SURVIVED THE WIDENING, which is the only
reason it may now be stated about the repository rather than about one
crate: `an-unplaced-end-is-labelled-an-unplaced-start`, the placement field
relabel, reddens exactly ONE test of the 1843 —
`the_frame_view_names_at_each_point_what_the_playable_world_counts_there`.
Nothing anywhere else distinguishes the three reasons a coordinate cannot be
placed, because nothing else joins the placement surface to a verdict about
the fact. The other six are caught by 3-10 tests each, which is what a
shared read looks like: `the-walk-never-admits-it-could-not-compare` takes
down two surface walks beside this contract, so LAW ORDER is not this file's
alone even though the qualification it states is.
THE TWO MEASUREMENTS ARE HELD AGAINST EACH OTHER rather than one replacing
the other. Restricting this run's reds to the tests `-p mnemosyne-cli` can
reach gives 9, 5, 4, 2, 5, 3 and 1 — the `2-9 tests each` and the `ONE` the
Round 1138 prose reported, reproduced without re-running the narrow sweep.
A widening that could not reproduce the narrower answer would have been two
runs of different things rather than one question asked twice.
AND THE SET BELOW IS DECLARED EXHAUSTIVE (Round 1140), so each `expect_red`
names the WHOLE red set rather than a floor under it. That is what holds the
sentences above to a later run: a test deleted, a guard added, or this sweep
run at a narrower scope again all come back as reds this manifest does not
name, where a floor is silent in both directions and the prose beside it goes
on claiming the old number. It is the only manifest in this repository that
may make the claim, because it is the only one whose whole red set anybody
has measured.
AND IT WAS RE-MEASURED ON THE FOLDED TREE (Round 1186), because the tree it
was measured against no longer exists: R1148 and R1171 folded 157 test
targets into 82, and the suite went from 1843 tests to 1980. Five of the
seven red sets came back unchanged, which is the claim holding. TWO DID NOT,
and not because they had decayed — R1184 DELETED two names from them that
were never stale. `tests::report_frame_view_branch_reaches_the_answer` and
`tests::report_frame_view_order_path_reaches_the_answer` are generated by
`macro_rules! exercised!` in `mnemosyne-mcp`, so the `syn` walk that reads
`#[test] fn` names out of source cannot see them, and it answered `this tree
does not have that test` about two tests this tree runs and this sweep
reddens. They are restored here by measurement: the run that found them named
them as reds this manifest did not name, which under an exhaustive claim is
the one report that could have said so.

injections.name: a-frame-view-draws-from-every-frame
injections.why: the whole claim of this read is that a view never mixes frames (R433); without the filter every frame answers about every fact, so LAW ONE FRAME sees one fact named under two frames and LAW HOLDING sees the union count several times over

injections.name: a-frame-view-draws-from-every-road
injections.why: world membership (R438) is what makes a view a view of ONE world-line; with the Out arm removed a sibling road's facts enter this road's population, and LAW POPULATION is the join that says the frames' populations together are exactly what this road accounts for

injections.name: an-undecidable-verdict-is-reported-as-a-definite-one
injections.why: B-1 honesty is the reason this read has three classes and not two: a coordinate the declaration cannot compare to the query point is `unknown`, never `not_holding`. Collapsed, the view answers a definite NO about facts nothing decided — the failure that reads as a clean answer, and LAW UNDECIDABLE is what the other read's placement surfaces catch it with

injections.name: no-view-admits-it-is-a-confluence-fragment
injections.why: one `is_confluence` feeds three surfaces — the fork tree's `converges`, the manuscript's marker and this one — so a reader holding a fragment can tell it from a playthrough. Pinned false here, the frame view calls a prefix-less fragment a road, and LAW FRAGMENT is the only place the third surface is held against the other two

injections.name: every-seat-is-the-first-scene-of-the-road
injections.why: LAW SEAT is the half no manuscript ask can reach: the runtime meets a fact where the locator seats it, and the frame view says whether it is true there. Pinned to the head of the walk, every seat lands before the truth it points at while the view goes on holding the fact — R949's class, inverted

injections.name: the-walk-never-admits-it-could-not-compare
injections.why: the linearization is ONE reading of a partial order and `undeclared_adjacencies` is where the read says so. Emptied, a replay of the events and the two reads differ with nothing in either answer to explain it — which is exactly LAW ORDER, and the reason Round 1056's `the count is a function of the events` needed a qualification the authored corpora could not show

injections.name: an-unplaced-end-is-labelled-an-unplaced-start
injections.why: `unplaced_facts` names three FIELDS and they are three different reasons a coordinate cannot be placed — a start the walk never reaches, an end it never reaches, a successor's seat it never reaches — and the frame view's verdict differs for each. Relabelled, the placement surface still lists the same facts and says the wrong thing about every one of them
